name: Names Of God
overview: The Names of God revealed in Scripture demonstrate His character and relationship with His people, emphasizing His eternal nature, provision, healing, protection, and peace. From God as the Creator in Genesis 1:1 to the self-existent I AM in Exodus 3:14, these names reveal His unchanging presence and power. Names like Jehovahjireh (The Lord will provide), Jehovahnissi (The Lord my banner), and Jehovahshalom (The Lord send peace) highlight God's active care and deliverance for His people, affirming His role as provider, protector, and healer as shown in the Exodus and Judges accounts.
